items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Well we played numbers like High Society, Millenburg Joy, no numbers like that.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well what did René Parker sing? He said Creole, what did I sing Creole? Yeah, he sang. He sang Elabar and things like that, yeah. And what about the people down there in Blackmon? And what number did they like?
Well we played numbers like High Society, Millenburg Joy, no numbers like that.
